senses.sense_definition: A female given name, often a short form of <w>Cherilyn</w>, famously associated with the American singer and actress.

examples.text: She decided to name her daughter <w>Cher</w> after her favorite pop icon from the seventies.
Many people do not realize that <w>Cher</w> can be a nickname for longer names like Cherilyn.

senses.sense_definition: A department of Centre-Val de Loire, France, with its capital at Bourges.

examples.text: We spent our summer vacation exploring the historic towns in the department of <w>Cher</w>.
Bourges is the administrative capital of <w>Cher</w> and is famous for its gothic cathedral.

senses.sense_definition: A left tributary of the Loire river in central France.

examples.text: The beautiful Château de Chenonceau is built directly over the river <w>Cher</w>.
We took a peaceful boat tour along the calm waters of the <w>Cher</w> during our trip.

senses.sense_definition: An alternative spelling of <w>'cher</w>, used as a term of endearment meaning dear or darling.

examples.text: He smiled warmly and said, "Don't worry about it, <w>cher</w>, everything will be fine."
In Cajun English, it is common to hear people address their loved ones as <w>cher</w>.

traits.comment: Used as an informal term of endearment
